data.one_liner: Unofficial Amazon Cognito Identity Provider SDK for Dart and Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides an unofficial client library for Amazon Cognito Identity to handle user sign-up, sign-in, sessions, and MFA in Dart and Flutter applications. It is based on amazon-cognito-identity-js.
use_when: You need to authenticate users using AWS Cognito in a Flutter or Dart app.
You want an alternative to Amplify Flutter specifically for Cognito Identity management.
avoid_when: You prefer using official and fully supported AWS plugins like Amplify Flutter.
Your project does not use Amazon Cognito as an identity provider.
strengths: Supports a wide range of Cognito features including MFA, custom challenges, and refresh token rotation.
Works across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: It is an unofficial SDK, meaning it might lag behind official AWS updates.
Official AWS support recommends using Amplify Flutter instead.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up an AWS Cognito User Pool and Client ID, then initializing the CognitoUserPool object.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose if you are using Firebase as your backend instead of AWS Cognito.
